identity_policy: Match original named game and description; accept original-language sources; do not invent replacement IDs or substitute different editions without evidence. No new ID correction this pass.
safety_and_scope: Read-only public sources only. No seller/designer contact, purchases, form submission, JavaScript/Flash/game module execution, TLS bypass, hidden media extraction or invented CDN signatures. Public gallery actually offered every accepted image URL.
